svg.aria-label: Architecture of the proposed Farm Sight world model: observations are harmonized and encoded, a two-clock world model predicts how the field changes given the crop and the weather, a rule program anchors, masks and verifies it, and a planner searches rotations across climate models.
svg.text: Proposed neurosymbolic architecture. Design, not yet trained.
1 OBSERVATIONS, EACH AT ITS OWN SHARPNESS AND TEMPO
one row per field per 16 days; every value
tagged with its native cell size and cadence

and nitrogen legacy of earlier crops
